_comment: What the Chaffee Provides site shows. The Food Web publishes every record statewide and scripts/sync_data.py applies this scope when it syncs; these are choices about the site, not about the facts. county_fips: the counties the site covers. include_sources: a record that one of these sources lists is kept even if the Food Web has no county for it. include_categories is an allowlist (a record with categories stays only if one is listed). exclude_categories drops a record whose categories are all listed. exclude_slugs drops a record. hide_pin_slugs keeps a record in the list but off the map. show_unconfirmed_home_pins gives a home-base pin to records whose sales channels are not confirmed. include_outlet_kinds is the shop kinds shown.

exclude_slugs.cottonwood-spirit-ranch: Not applicable for now: mostly a vacation rental that sells beef to guests (Alycen Quattrocchi, Oct 13 2026)

exclude_categories.Agritourism: Guidestone does not want agritourism on the Chaffee Provides site (user, 2026-10-15)
exclude_categories.Bakery: Bakeries are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (user, 2026-10-15)
exclude_categories.Restaurant: Restaurants are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (JP provider, 2026-10-15)
exclude_categories.Caterer: Caterers are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (JP provider, 2026-10-15)

hide_pin_slugs.everett-ranch-beef: Social media only; listed so people can message them, but not shown on the map (user, 2026-10-15)
